signatures.head: def QuasicategoryEnrichedDiagram.mappingSimplex {C : Type v} [Category.{u} C] [SimplicialCategory C] {J : Type u} [Category.{u} J] (D : QuasicategoryEnrichedDiagram C J) (X Y : C) {n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ} (θ : (SimplicialCategory.sHom X Y).obj n) : strictDiagramMappingSimplex (D.evaluate X ⋙ quasicategoryObjectForget) (D.evaluate Y ⋙ quasicategoryObjectForget) n
def rightStraighteningInfinityMap (B : SSet.{u}) : RightFibrationInfinity B ⟶ PresheafInfinity B := rightFibrationOppositeInfinityMap B ≫ leftStraighteningInfinityMap B.op

lemma rightStraighteningInfinityMap_isFullyFaithful (B : SSet.{u}) [Quasicategory B] : IsFullyFaithful (rightStraighteningInfinityMap B) := (rightFibrationOppositeInfinityMap_isQCatEquivalence B).isFullyFaithful.comp (leftStraighteningInfinityMap_isFullyFaithful B.op)

lemma rightStraighteningInfinityMap_isQCatEquivalence (B : SSet.{u}) [Quasicategory B] : IsQCatEquivalence (rightStraighteningInfinityMap B) := (rightFibrationOppositeInfinityMap_isQCatEquivalence B).comp (leftStraighteningInfinityMap_isQCatEquivalence B.op)

theorem kanQuillen_model_exists : ∃ m : ModelCategory SSet.{u}, @cofibrations SSet.{u} _ m.categoryWithCofibrations = MorphismProperty.monomorphisms SSet.{u} ∧ @fibrations SSet.{u} _ m.categoryWithFibrations = SSet.modelCategoryQuillen.J.{u}.rlp ∧ @weakEquivalences SSet.{u} _ m.categoryWithWeakEquivalences = SimplicialModelInputs.geometricWeakEquivalences.{u}
noncomputable def kanQuillenModel : ModelCategory SSet.{u} := Classical.choose kanQuillen_model_exists
def markedSeed : X.Subcomplex := A ⊔ inverseWitnessSeed s hs
instance small_markedSeed [∀ d, Small.{u} (A.obj d)] [Small.{u} ι] (d : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) : Small.{u} ((markedSeed A s hs).obj d)

3.2.3.1.decision: native simplicial resolution はあるが、SetΔ+ 全体での T(M) とその右随伴 U、および同じ Cartesian ModelCategory での Quillen equivalence の比較はない。unmarked resolution のホモトピー同値だけはこの随伴を供給しない。
